I have been farming here in Lilongwe for many years, and maize is what feeds my family. With the rains coming, I will use my FISP coupons to buy NPK and urea for this plot, because without fertilizer the soil gives us nothing. I will also plant the hybrid seed they provide at the depot, since it yields better than our local maize if the rains are good. I do not have money for chemicals or irrigation pipes, so we will depend on the rains and our own hands, though I may need to hire a few ganyu workers when it is time to weed and harvest.
